experience.description: Architecting DevSecOps, MLOps, and Data Engineering Cloud Architectures.
experience.techStack: GCP (BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Composer, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, GKE, VPC, Secret Manager, Terraform, Python, FastAPI, MLflow, GitLab CI/CD, Docker, LangGraph, LlamaIndex)
details: First software engineer — designed and built the company's first pilot and MVP from scratch.
Defined the MVP architecture that became the foundation for multiple products and clients.
Designed end-to-end MLOps pipelines using GitLab CI/CD, Cloud Build, Artifact Registry and Cloud Run.
Implemented MLflow tracking and model registry, integrated with BigQuery and GCS for dataset/experiment lineage.
Built streaming and batch ETL/ELT pipelines using Dataflow (Beam), Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions and Composer.
Designed scalable multi-agent AI architectures using LlamaIndex and LangGraph with session, state, and event orchestration.
Implemented full IaC using Terraform modules for Cloud Run services, VPC, Serverless connectors, IAM policies, Secret Manager, and security enforcement.
Developed secure DevSecOps blueprints: CI/CD standards, boilerplates, naming conventions, secret rotation, vulnerability scanning.
Mentored engineers on GCP, Terraform, DevSecOps, and AI architecture best practices.

experience.description: Designing scalable backend services and event-driven architectures.
experience.techStack: AWS (Lambda, EKS, ECS, API Gateway, SNS, SQS, EC2, Kinesis Firehose, CodePipeline, CloudWatch, CloudFormation, CloudFront, VPC, AIM), Python, NodeJs, Fast API, Serverless, SCRUM & Jira
details: First software engineer — designed and built the company's first pilot and MVP from scratch.
Spearheaded the design and implementation of AWS cloud architectures using CloudFormation and C4 methodology, ensuring scalability and reliability of services.
Developed RESTful services and microservices using ECS, EC2, RDS, Lambda, DynamoDB, SNS, SQS, and S3.
Implemented comprehensive unit tests using Pytest and conducted load testing with Locust.
Established CI/CD pipelines using CodeBuild and CodePipeline, automating the deployment process.
Mentored and supported team members, fostering a collaborative and growth-oriented work environment.
Designed multi-tenant SaaS backend using hexagonal architecture and domain-driven design, with cursor-based pagination and caching strategies.

experience.description: Engineering Lead for Frontend Architecture & GraphQL Integration.
experience.techStack: AWS (Lambda, EKS, ECS, API Gateway, SNS, SQS, EC2), Python, NodeJs, Fast API, Serverless, SCRUM & Jira
details: Provided technical leadership as a Tech Lead, guiding the team in frontend development using React and GraphQL.
Orchestrated the creation of proxies with Apollo and GraphQL to streamline data fetching and management in frontend applications.
Prototyped mockups and wireframes using Figma, enabling visualization and validation of design concepts.

experience.description: Designed Scalable Serverless Architectures & Data-Driven Microservices.
experience.techStack: AWS (Lambda, EKS, ECS, API Gateway, SNS, SQS, EC2), Python, NodeJs, Fast API, Serverless, SCRUM & Jira
details: First software engineer — designed and built the company's first pilot and MVP from scratch.
Led a team in the development and testing of frontend applications, delivering intuitive user interfaces.
Designed database architecture using Entity-Relationship diagrams, ensuring optimal data storage and retrieval efficiency.
Developed serverless microservices on AWS, leveraging Lambda and other cloud services to build scalable and resilient backend solutions.
Implemented RESTful and GraphQL services to facilitate data communication between frontend and backend systems.
Established CI/CD pipelines to automate the build, test, and deployment processes.
Built public-facing REST and GraphQL APIs with JWT/OAuth2 auth, rate limiting, and versioning following JSON:API standards.
